dct_description_sm: Arctic cod is the main food source for seals, whales, and birds in the Beaufort Sea, and previous research has documented the winter distribution and ecology of Arctic cod, but little is known about its summer offshore distribution. This cutting-edge project, led by ArcticNet, used state-of-the-art fisheries sonar technology to map the distribution and abundance of Arctic cod and other fish in the offshore Beaufort Sea during the summer months. The research results informed decision-making for offshore oil exploration and development by: (1) Assessing the importance of the summer ecology of the species in offshore oil and gas license blocks, and (2) Providing missing information about the summer distribution of Arctic cod and other fish needed to gauge the impacts of a potential future oil spill in the license blocks.
dct_title_s: Active Acoustic Mapping of Fish in the Beaufort Sea
